items.title: Ask a Scientist: How do researchers use AI to predict a cyclone?

summaries.en: A Google DeepMind scientist details AI's role in weather prediction, particularly for cyclones. items.title: How the GNIS Lake Ontario/Lake America name change in the U.S. will appear in Maps
items.content: The U.S. Geographic Names Information System (GNIS) has formally changed the name for "Lake Ontario" to "Lake America" in the United States. Since we update Google Maps …
items.contentSnippet: The U.S. Geographic Names Information System (GNIS) has formally changed the name for "Lake Ontario" to "Lake America" in the United States. Since we update Google Maps …

summaries.zh: 美国地理名称信息系统（GNIS）正式将“安大略湖”更名为“美洲湖”。该变更将在美国谷歌地图等系统中体现。
summaries.en: The U.S. Geographic Names Information System (GNIS) has officially renamed "Lake Ontario" to "Lake America" within the U.S. This change will be reflected in updated maps, including Google Maps. The adjustment aligns with GNIS's standardized naming practices for geographic features. The new name appears in the GNIS database, affecting related map updates. The change is part of a broader effort to standardize geographic names across federal datasets. No further details are provided about the rationale or impact of the name change.

items.summary: 美国地理名称信息系统（GNIS）正式将“安大略湖”更名为“美洲湖”。该变更将在美国谷歌地图等系统中体现。
